name: ai-game-dashboard
description: AI Game Dashboard - A unified platform to access multiple AI-powered games

scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n "Dashboard,五子棋,马里奥,AI计算,终极数学,单词卡" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgYellow.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgRed.bold" "npm run serve" "npm run dev:wuziqi" "npm run dev:mario" "npm run dev:calc" "npm run dev:ultramath" "npm run dev:lingocard"
scripts.install:all: npm run install:wuziqi && npm run install:mario && npm run install:calc && npm run install:ultramath && npm run install:lingocard
scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/ && cp index.css dist/ && cp favicon.png dist/ && cp -r assets dist/ && npm run install:all && npm run build:wuziqi && npm run build:mario && npm run build:calc && npm run build:ultramath && npm run build:lingocard && mkdir -p dist/aistudio-wuziqi && cp -r aistudio-wuziqi/dist/* dist/aistudio-wuziqi/ && mkdir -p dist/minecraft-mario && cp -r minecraft-mario/dist/* dist/minecraft-mario/ && mkdir -p dist/aistudio-calc && cp -r aistudio-calc/dist/* dist/aistudio-calc/ && mkdir -p dist/ultramath && cp -r ultramath/dist/* dist/ultramath/ && mkdir -p dist/lingocard-genai && cp -r lingocard-genai/dist/* dist/lingocard-genai/
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && echo 'Setup complete! Run npm run dev to start the dashboard.'

author: AI Game Studio
